thread:
marta: Heads-up: small but important relnotes thread. Need two microcopy decisions and a few snippet fixes. Items: rename 'beta' label to 'preview' in changelog, embed streaming deprecation banner + migration link, and add tokens_consumed to example outputs for SDK QA.

kevin: Quick Q on rename: do we do a site-wide replace from 'beta' -> 'preview' or only in relnotes/changelog? Search/replace could be noisy.

marta: Only in release-facing copy and changelog entries. Add a short note in the changelog saying: "We are renaming beta to preview for consistency." No redirects needed.

jia: For the embed streaming deprecation, what's the cut-off date we should list? Legal asked for a 60-day minimum notice.

marta: Let's announce: "Embedding streaming will be deprecated on 2026-06-15." Include a link to the migration checklist and an inline one-line example of the new batch call. Keep the banner concise.

sam: I'll update the Python and Go embed examples to show the new `batch_embed` call. Also will add a tiny opt-out snippet (deprecated) with a bold one-liner callout. For QA, do we want examples to print `tokens_consumed` and `tokens_billed`?

marta: Yes, add both keys. Docs QA checklist should require that examples output `model`, `request_id`, `tokens_consumed`, and `tokens_billed`. Short and machine-parseable.

kevin: For JS/TS streaming -> polling change, I'll put the polling example first and keep the streaming example collapsed under a deprecation note. I'll also add a tiny test script example `node test_poll.js` that asserts response has the keys you listed.

oliver: Product wants a single-sentence billing callout for Dedicated autoscale: "Autoscale pools support optional burst buckets; bursts consume burst credits billed at the burst rate." Finance will confirm exact phrasing.

release-bot: Draft relnotes page created at /docs/releases/2026-04-12-relnotes-microcopy. PR 5120.

marta: Owners: changelog microcopy & banners -> marta; JS/TS snippets + test script -> kevin; Go/Python embed updates -> jia; QA checklist -> sam; product billing confirm -> oliver. Please add :eyes: on the PR when you push changes.

sam: One more: add a short migrate checklist section header with these bullets: 1) run examples locally, 2) run smoke tester against canary, 3) confirm tokens_consumed in logs, 4) update user-facing app copy. I'll add exact commands in the scaffold.

marta: Great. Let's keep this tight. I'll assemble the relnotes blurb and ping for signoff before merge.

kevin: ETA: JS PR by EOD PST. jia: Go/Python tomorrow AM. Sam: QA scaffold later today.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: relnotes editorial signoff in 9 hours.
